findings.rationale: Ubuntu rates this local, high-complexity glibc fopen ccs-mode issue Medium and has deferred a fix. Alloy does not construct fopen mode strings from user input.
findings.mitigation: Run the log agent as a restricted, read-only container without an interactive shell or arbitrary local-code path; monitor the Ubuntu Noble package and rebuild immediately when a fixed package is published.

findings.rationale: Ubuntu rates this local, high-complexity incremental restore issue Medium and reports no upstream patch. The runtime container does not perform incremental backups or restore attacker-writable directories.
findings.mitigation: Do not use the Alloy container for backup or archive restoration; keep its filesystem and privileges restricted and replace the base package when Ubuntu publishes a fix.

findings.rationale: The issue requires extracting an untrusted archive with --one-top-level as a security boundary. The Alloy runtime neither accepts archives nor invokes tar.
findings.mitigation: Never extract untrusted archives in the Alloy runtime; retain read-only filesystems and low privileges, and rebuild when a fixed Ubuntu package is available.

findings.rationale: Alloy does not expose or mount a Docker socket and the affected Docker daemon plugin-install path is not executed.
findings.mitigation: Keep Docker discovery disabled, do not mount a Docker socket, and enforce the matching OpenVEX deployment constraint.
